### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s).

**27** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a`.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0063314334246c25fd0a28d2ef95b4b4e4bcf4fa` — the merge of head `fb1c5bc9636b4de1e297d66f4a7f167acbb60f66` into base `399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0063314334246c25fd0a28d2ef95b4b4e4bcf4fa && git checkout 0063314334246c25fd0a28d2ef95b4b4e4bcf4fa
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a fb1c5bc9636b4de1e297d66f4a7f167acbb60f66 && git checkout -B drift-repro 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a && git merge --no-ff fb1c5bc9636b4de1e297d66f4a7f167acbb60f66

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 399df5bba888ff7cf7531d01d8dcb61d7690438a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6a70094d28734caf6f7440f866fc79c9dbded851`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts + packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts, packages/spec/src/shared/record-proto-key-guard.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/README.md, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx, .changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md

Inputs: card #29366 (body, triage 6580329038, claim 6581882084, os-dev-report 6583545776), PR #29513 body and file list, the net diff of `6a70094d` against its merge base with `main` (`cafe8ee6`; `origin/main` is 20 commits ahead, `git merge-tree` of the two is conflict-free), the check-runs on `6a70094d`, and the live tree at `6a70094d` read with `git show`. Check-runs at review time: 31 success, 8 skipped, 0 failure, 23 still in progress (Test Core 2–6 and 8, Test UI 1–3, 5–7 and 9–16, Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace). Green already: Build Core, Test Core 1 and 7, Type Check · consumer gates, Check Changeset, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check · source gates, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate (vacuous on a `pull_request` event: both shards skip, zero attestations). The landing still waits for the pending runs to conclude green; nothing in them is contradicted by the tree.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept-set narrowing on `ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches` keys — right, and it is a narrowing, not a location-only move.** Read at every door that parses an object extension: `defineStack` / `defineObjectExtension` is the pure schema (no target judge). The `/api/v1/meta` `object_extension` save door judges the body with `OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_SCHEMA = z.preprocess(withoutProtectionEnvelope, ObjectExtensionSchema)` and its own refusal `objectExtensionItemRefusal` asks six questions (package binding, registry `extend` refusals, row name = target, target registered under the spelled key, closure, `__c` suffix via `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`) — `fieldPatchTargetMisses` / `fieldPatchTargetRefusals` is not among them, so a `fieldPatches: { Industry: … }` row was stored. The registry fold (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` ~4650) calls `fieldPatchTargetMisses` twice and hands both lists to `reportFieldPatchMisses`: the comment says "Never drops, never refuses" and the code does exactly that — the patch is left out of the merge and logged. `os validate` (`packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts`) judges only targets in the composed stack ("A target outside the stack is not judged here; the install door judges it"). The marketplace install door (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2145`, `fieldPatchTargetRefusalsOf`) is the only one that always refused. The only non-test callers of the judge in the whole tree are those four (cli, cloud-connection, objectql ×2, metadata-core itself). So the dev's measurement (brief item a) holds in the cited code: three doors accepted such a key end to end, which makes this `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING, with the semantic entry — the branch the delta prescribes for that reading.
2. **`ObjectSchema.fields`' accept set is unchanged byte for byte — right (brief item b).** The diff removes `z.string().regex(/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/, { message: 'Field names must be lowercase snake_case (e.g., "first_name", "company", "annual_revenue")' })` from inside `z.record(…, FieldSchema)` and hoists the identical regex and identical message to the module constant `FieldNameKeySchema` (object.zod.ts:2779), then writes `z.record(FieldNameKeySchema, FieldSchema)` with no record-level params. Same regex, same message, no error map on that record, and zod 4's record places a key failure as one `invalid_key` at `[key]`, so the path stays `fields.KEY`; the `constructor` / `prototype` refines and the `__proto__` raw guard around it are untouched. The derivation is one declaration read twice — the delta's "do not write a second regex" is met.
3. **Issue location `fieldPatches.KEY`, not bare `fieldPatches` — right (brief item c; dev deviation 1).** The delta's words "at `fieldPatches`" would need a hand-rolled `superRefine` with a static slot path, which would (i) disagree with `ObjectSchema.fields`' own placement at `fields.KEY`, the very agreement the card asks for, (ii) disagree with the sibling option-key refusal from PR #29331 at `fieldPatches.FIELD.options.KEY`, and (iii) lose the key a Studio form highlights. Zod's record key path is the right reading of the delta; the test pins `['fieldPatches', key]` and the agreement test pins it equal to `fields.KEY` over 11 keys.
4. **No public surface change — right.** `FieldNameKeySchema` is a non-exported `const`; `z.infer` of the record is still `Record<string, FieldDisplayPatch>`, so no consumer type moves (`check:api-surface` has nothing to see). The delta's "no new public export expected" holds; `open_questions` is rightly empty.
5. **Generated artifacts — right.** `packages/spec/json-schema/` is gitignored and built in CI (the key regex now publishes as `propertyNames.pattern` on `ObjectExtension.fieldPatches`, the same projection `ObjectSchema.fields` already carries — a published tightening consistent with the declared narrowing). `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json` lists `data/ObjectExtension:fieldPatches` as a path only, no pattern. `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` is regenerated for the moved describe; `content/docs/references/api/package-api-assembled.mdx` prints `fieldPatches?: Record<string, object>` and is unaffected. The record `error` map is not a refinement, so `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`'s `data/ObjectExtension` row gains no site. The migration registry is generated from `entries/` (no index to edit — README "Touch no other file for the entry"), and `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragments are for retirements with a D2 conversion; a refusal-only semantic entry adds none (`18.object-duplicate-action-name-refused` added none either).
6. **`ui/**` mirror (brief item e) — right, none.** `git grep` of `ui/packages` and `ui/apps` for `fieldPatches` / `ObjectExtensionSchema` hits only `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` (reads `ext.fieldPatches` as a plain record keyed by the target's own field names, writes the same way), `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `plugin-tree/ObjectTree.tsx` (prose). No zod twin redeclares the record, so there is no objectui#7715-class drift to pin.
7. **Authored forms — right.** Every authored `fieldPatches` block in `examples/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` (references excluded), templates and dogfood/test fixtures keys by a snake_case name (`industry` in the skill and the guide; the deliberate `region__c` / `__proto__` refusal fixtures are refused by their own rules, not the grammar). Nothing in the repository newly refuses; the guide's example is pinned whole as a CONTROL test.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, `**BREAKING**` banner, line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (the same two lines head the PR body, matching the claim 6581882084), exactly one disposition marker `adr-0087: registered object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused` whose id resolves to the new entry file, and a `FROM → TO` line (`{ Industry: … }` → `{ industry: … }`, key by field name never label). Per AGENTS Post-Task 3: a value refused / requirement tightened is `narrowed`; a kind takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves; `(narrowing)` is BREAKING and carries its migration — all met. Check Changeset is green on this head. Not `skip-changeset` (spec publishes), not `patch` (a protocol kind), not `major` (the no-major gate holds). `Clause-②:` line correct — see ①.1 for why it is `no (narrowing)` and not `semantic`: the target judge did not reach the save door, the boot fold or an out-of-stack `os validate` target.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: [] — none owed. No new public name, no product fork.
- Deviation 1 (`fieldPatches.KEY` vs the delta's "at `fieldPatches`") — accepted, see ①.3.
- Deviation 2 (branch not re-merged): `origin/main` is now 20 commits past `cafe8ee6`; `git merge-tree` is clean. Main's drift on files this PR touches or reads is `registry.ts.template` (a `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment for `ui-view-personal-declarations-retired`, different lines), `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` (the `sharing` row, a different line) and metadata-protocol files this diff does not edit. Entry ids are unique and generated sorted, so no semantic conflict; the regen merge is the queue leg's `os-regen-merge.sh` as usual. Accepted.
- Deviation 3 (assignee/reviewer unset) — the seat's, not the dev's. Deviation 4 (`pnpm lint` not run locally) — Lint · ESLint and the three Lint gate jobs are green on the head.
- Out-of-scope class b (`ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` keyed by bare `z.string()`, brief item f): confirmed in the live tree — object.zod.ts:5036 reads `fields: refuseRecordProtoKey(z.record(z.string(), FieldSchema), 'fields')`, so `{ extend: 'crm_account', fields: { 'Region Code': { type: 'text', … } } }` parses and an extension can add a field the target's own `fields` map would refuse by name. Same family, same one-line fix (`FieldNameKeySchema`), same declaration shape (a narrowing that reaches the save door too). Rightly kept out of this card's diff (the card names `fieldPatches` only, and the declaration and migration entry are per surface). **Escalate: no open card exists for it (issue search finds none) — the seat files one.**
- Out-of-scope class a (dogfood: `flow-runas.dogfood.test.ts` ×3 at `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` on `runas_note`, `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest.dogfood.test.ts` ×1, brief item f): **pre-existing, confirmed from the tree, not from the check-runs** — the dogfood shards carry `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`, so this head's Dogfood Regression Gate success counts zero attestations and says nothing. The confirmation is `6af3d295` on `origin/main` (`test(dogfood): re-point the runAs and anonymous-guest flow pins to flow start admission's record rule (#29451)`, Fixes #29426), which landed AFTER the merge base `cafe8ee6` and edits exactly those two files: the reds the dev measured on the merge base are #29365's intended behaviour change, already re-pinned on main. No action for this PR; the re-merge at queue time takes the fix.
- Noted-not-filed (`fieldPatches: { constructor: … }` parses — it is a snake_case word; `ObjectSchema.fields` refuses it by a record refine, not by the key schema): right to leave — parity with the key schema is what the card asked, the two reserved names are a separate rule, and the target judge refuses an unknown field at install / `os validate`.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`** — judged against the card's ruling (key `fieldPatches` by the schema that keys `ObjectSchema.fields`, one `invalid_key` with a prescription) and its first consumers (the `object_extension` save door, the sync's `registrableObjectExtension`, the registry fold). Holds. Attempts to break it:
- Load order (#5593 block): `FieldNameKeySchema` is a module `const` at line 2779, above `ObjectSchemaBase` (line ~3159) which reads it eagerly; `ObjectExtensionSchema` is a `lazySchema` and reads it later. No temporal dead zone.
- Sharing one key-schema instance between two records: zod 4 schemas are immutable; the record-level `error` map lives on the `fieldPatches` record's own def, so it cannot leak onto `ObjectSchema.fields`.
- The `error` map returns `undefined` for every code but `invalid_key`, so the record's own `invalid_type` keeps zod's sentence; `String(issue.input)` reads the key zod hands as the `invalid_key` issue's input, and the test pins the message opens with that key.
- `__proto__` matches the grammar but never reaches it: `refuseRecordProtoKey` still wraps the record and refuses it on the raw input first, as before. `region__c` matches the grammar and reaches the root `__c` refinement exactly once (CONTROL pins one `custom` issue, no double refusal). `constructor` — see ③.
- Prescription text: names the rule (lowercase snake_case), two examples, "never by its label", no tracker number (test pins `not.toMatch(/#\d{3,}/)`). The describe and the doc comment name the grammar.
- Tests beside it: four refusals, two CONTROLs (including the guide's authored example parsed whole) and an agreement test over 11 keys that reads admission off `ObjectSchema.fields`' own parse rather than restating the regex, with a vacuity guard both ways. The dev's ablation (`FieldNameKeySchema` → `z.string()` on the `fieldPatches` record: 5 red, controls green) shows the tests can fail.
- No finding.

**`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts`** — judged against ADR-0087 D3, its siblings (`18.object-duplicate-action-name-refused.ts`, `18.metadata-item-name-grammar-enforced.ts`) and its consumers (`os migrate meta`'s TODO list, the upgrade guide, the changeset marker). Holds. The file carries the `SemanticMigration` shape its siblings do (`id`, `surface`, `replacement`, `reason`, `acceptanceCriteria`; no `conversionIds` because no D2 conversion exists — right, a respelling can land on another field or none, so the author owns the choice, exactly the duplicate-action sibling's argument), the filename is `18.` + id as the README derives it, the id is kebab-case and unique in `entries/`, the changeset's `registered` marker names it, and no other file is touched for it (README rule 1). The `reason` states the measured doors truthfully (matches ①.1) and the `acceptanceCriteria` gives the author a verify loop (`os validate` passes; a stored row is refused `INVALID_METADATA` until renamed).
- **should-fix (follow-up card acceptable, not this PR's FAIL):** the entry's own acceptance criteria promise that a stored `object_extension` row carrying such a key "no longer parses, so the sync … names the row (`INVALID_METADATA`)" — and the save door did store such rows (①.1). The sibling for the same class, `object-duplicate-action-name-refused`, also registered a detector in `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`) so `os migrate meta --stored` names the row BEFORE the upgrade refuses it ("never silence"); this entry registers none, so an operator learns of the row only at boot. Either add the detector (one predicate: a `fieldPatches` key the grammar refuses, keyed by this entry's id, which `refused-shapes.test.ts` already requires to be a step-18 semantic id) or record in the entry why the stored pass cannot reach an `object_extension` row (`applyConversionsToStoredItem` maps a row by `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` / `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`; whether `object_extension` is in either was not read here). Several `18.*-refused` siblings carry no detector either, so this is the family's gap, not a defect that fails the entry.

**Verdict reasoning.** Both `hits` files hold against the cited code and the scenario they are accepted against; the declaration pair is the one the measurement supports; no must-fix. The record is rendered on the tree, not on the PR body: every claim above was re-read in `git show 6a70094d:…`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fb1c5bc9636b4de1e297d66f4a7f167acbb60f66`
Local-runs: none

This is a DELTA record for the pushes after the PASS record 6583861239 (head `6a70094d`). Three commits: `e089e41f` (prose in the ADR-0087 entry and the changeset), `c9bd6e10` (a merge of `main` by `os-regen-merge.sh`), `fb1c5bc9` (the regenerated `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` on the merged tree). Against the merge base the PR is still the same 6 files, +168/−15. `object.zod.ts`, the tests and the key schema are byte-identical to `6a70094d`.

- **Should-fix (a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector): answered by measurement, accepted.** I read the claim in the tree. `applyConversionsToStoredItem` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`) wraps a row in `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL[type] ?? STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS[type]` and returns the item untouched when neither names a collection. `object_extension` is in neither (`STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS` holds only `translation`/`translations`; the manifest spelling map has no extension entry). So the stored pass runs no conversion and no detector over an `object_extension` row, and a detector would be dead code. The dev's probe agrees: the row comes back as the same reference with 0 TODOs and 0 notices, while the control object row gets its conversion.
- **The prose now says so.** The entry's comment and `acceptanceCriteria`, and the changeset's "Who sees it" line, say `os migrate meta --stored` does not list such a row and name the manual check (read each stored row's `fieldPatches` keys against the `fields` key grammar). That is true of the tree and is what an upgrader needs. Semver, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` carry unchanged from 6583861239.
- **Out of scope, filed separately:** no ADR-0087 conversion that walks `objectExtensions[]` replays over a stored `object_extension` row, for the same reason. Mapping `object_extension` → `objectExtensions` in `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS` would close that and make a detector reachable. Its own card.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象扩展 `fieldPatches` 的键改用与对象 `fields` 同一个键 schema（小写 snake_case），`Industry`、`Annual Revenue` 这类键在解析时就被拒，报一个带示例的 `invalid_key`。
- 为什么改：以前这种补丁在 `defineStack`、保存门和启动时都被接受，启动只在日志里点名、什么也不改；作者以为改了标签，界面却没变。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（BREAKING，spec minor，ADR-0087 语义条目已登记）。仓内无此写法；已存的坏键扩展行同步时整行注册失败，`os migrate meta --stored` 列不出它，条目里写了手工核对办法。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的 `FieldNameKeySchema` 与 `fieldPatches` 的报错文案。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-customization.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：可落地。契约复审 PASS（6583861239 @ `6a70094d`），delta PASS（6585110935）在现 head，CI 全绿。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec#2` · head `fb1c5bc9`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29366`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` sit at line start in the body and the changeset (`@objectstack/spec` minor, `!` subject, BREAKING). 6 files, +168/−15 against the merge base, inside claim 6581882084. No governed path (`check-governed-merges`: not governed).
2. **Premise measured:** before, a non-grammar `fieldPatches` key passed `defineStack`, the save door and the boot fold; on the head it is one `invalid_key` at `fieldPatches.KEY`, and a snake_case key and the `__c` rule are unchanged (the dev's ablation and controls, record 6583861239).
3. **Gates:** `ci-failure.mjs --sha fb1c5bc9…` GREEN: 65 check-runs, none failed. Dev readings on this head: spec 792/792, metadata-core, objectql, metadata-protocol green, 105 derived gates exit 0, dogfood 0 failed.
